acceptance_assessment: Initialization creates a fresh canonical UUID and registers it before publishing the project record; no approval receipt is created. Existing identities and canonical workflow state are refused.

Review prepares an exact current normalized control-input inventory and fixed offline policy. Activation requires the literal fingerprint decision, preserves hash-linked history, validates checkout/project registration and rechecks the package before publishing the receipt.

Copied project records alone lack local registration/decisions; copied decisions from a different Git common directory fail repository binding. Registered projects with deleted records remain on the project refusal path.
Malformed/stale/foreign inputs, linked inputs, interrupted operation locks and changed fingerprints hold authority. Partial initialization cannot silently generate a replacement identity.
The CLI exposes a usable status/init/review/activate/revoke lifecycle, including exact roots, paths with spaces and explicit interactive or noninteractive decisions. Recovery limits are documented.

The only tracked source diff inspected is the project-aware active_anchor adapter. Application sources are outside the package; ordinary src, application tests and README changes are excluded from the approval inventory.

Existing journal scheduling checks still enforce the original stream anchor; outcome recording and historical reads retain their existing exceptions. No task identifiers, budget reducers, attempt accounting or independent acceptance logic are changed.

Pilot execution retains separate profile, origin/objective/limits, checkout, implementation inventory and independent-review gates. Offline project approval does not supply that profile or broaden pilot permissions.
Legacy foundation compatibility when no project records or host registration exist is intentional, documented and covered by the historical export assertion; it is not treated as a defect.

The lifecycle tests contain substantive refusal, concurrency, interruption, copy, hardlink, worktree and journal-preservation assertions. No acceptance-blocking missing test was identified by static review.
All four independently calculated raw SHA-256 values match the handoff candidate.

verification_limitations: Static acceptance review only. No regression suite, focused test, application command, worker, provider or Docker execution was performed.

The supplied and documented evidence of final 111 passed/2 real-Docker deselected, earlier 113 journal compatibility passed, approval 46 passed and no-Tk 2 passed is prior implementation-owner evidence; this reviewer did not independently reproduce those results or inspect original run logs.
No new runtime, race, crash-durability, clean-machine or real-Docker proof is claimed. Filesystem and host operator remain trusted as documented; typed owner declarations are not authentication.

Review was bounded to the named package and concrete adjacent authority/journal risks. It does not accept project generation, complete OOP migration, full campaign behavior, deployment or integration.
This report is independent review input. The main agent remains responsible for verification, findings triage and final integration decisions.
